who.value: buyer watching a Live auction, entered in its giveaway (HK or MY)

stage.value: watching a live show while a giveaway runs

job.value: when picked, answer one easy question to win the giveaway; vote in the seller's polls

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: At rest it reads as the Live Show with a 'Giveaway 1 entry' pill; the 'You've been picked / Answer correctly to win' question only appears after the seller spins.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: At rest the orange 'Bid: S$20' slider is the most noticeable thing, which is right for the show; once picked, the question card's three answer rows take the top of the video and lead.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The answer rows are the answers themselves ('Apple', 'Chair', 'Shoe'); 'Bid: S$20', 'Custom', 'Share' and 'Shop' say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'You've been picked', 'Answer correctly to win' and 'You've got 1 more try' need no explaining; the timer shows as 0:24 with a draining bar.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The bank question is general knowledge ('Which of these is a fruit?'), answerable in seconds by anyone watching.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The giveaway stays a pill on the right edge until tapped, and the rules only surface at the moment they apply (the retry line after a wrong answer).

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen belongs to watching a live show: chat, the lot card, bid controls and the giveaway pill.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The question card is a one-line headline, one question and three one-word answers; nothing to read before acting.
